subject: [PATCH v3 06/12] mm/collapse: drop the collapse_possible() wrapper

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Expressed agreement with the removal of the collapse_possible() wrapper, citing improved code readability as a reason. Provided an Acked-by tag.

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch series aims to simplify the collapse_possible() function and its callers in the mm/collapse code by removing an unnecessary wrapper function. The collapse_possible_orders() function is directly called instead, eliminating a level of indirection.
